paragraphs.text: GujiGuji, a lightweight Codex-style desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness
# dsh-pet-gujiguji

GujiGuji is a desktop-only pet for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). It floats above
other windows, shows the

current project and activity only while the agent is
working, and does not render a second pet insid

nd activity only while the agent is
working, and does not render a second pet inside the dsh window.
English | 简体中文
## Features

- Drag the pet across every monitor on the Windows virtual desktop.
- Release a drag to let the pet

fall naturally. A quick flick throws it with
bounded velocity, gravity, wall bounce, floor friction

and a short
bottom-anchored landing squash.
- Dragging past the click threshold immediately switches

the pet into a visible
takeoff cycle. A released pet keeps that cycle while airborne, spreads its
w

ings near the floor, then restores the current task or idle pose after
landing.
- The task bubble te

mporarily hides while the pet is airborne, then returns
after the pet settles.
- While idle, the pet

plays a random gesture every 30–75 seconds using a
randomized delay and avoids repeating the same g

esture consecutively; the
interval can be adjusted from 15–150 seconds.
- Single-click plays one ran

dom gesture: head tilt, head stretch, spread
wings or side-wing wave. Every gesture starts and ends

in the standing pose.
- Double-click toggles the dsh window, then plays a randomized head tilt or
he

ad stretch so the interaction still has visible feedback.
- After a dsh turn completes successfully,

the pet performs two light hops;
failures, interruptions, and token-limit endings do not trigger it

.
- Gesture frames normalize the apparent head scale while allowing each pose
to keep its own positi

on and perspective.
- Both the pet and task bubble detect per-monitor work areas, shift away
from sc

reen edges and never straddle a dual-monitor boundary.
- Edge clearance follows the active pose inst

ead of reserving the widest wing
span while standing; wide gestures move inward only while they need

it.
- Double-click opens or hides the dsh window. If an active task bubble is
minimized, the same d

ouble-click restores it.
- Right-click for settings or to hide the pet.
- Settings support size, opa

city, throw power, idle interval, position lock
and reduced motion, with synchronized sliders and nu

meric input.
- The behaviour page can restore the default bottom-right position.
- The Codex-style t

ask bubble stays fixed at 284x65 and scrolls long activity
text horizontally. Idle shows no bubble a

nd no "idle" label.
- Every sprite frame is aligned to one shared foot line, so the pet rests
direct

ly on the work-area floor without clipping low frames.
- Wing gestures use the complete supplied sou

rce drawing. The generator never
cuts out or rotates individual wings, so faces and torsos stay inta

drawing. The generator never
cuts out or rotates individual wings, so faces and torsos stay intact.

The physical drag/throw roadmap, status interactions and size-reduction plan
are documented in docs/

(Chinese).
## Status mapping
| Source signal | Pet row | Label |

| any agent is `running` or the session has an open turn | `running` | Running |
| `approval/request

` open | `waiting` | Waiting |
| `agent/error` within 4 s | `failed` | Failed |
| otherwise | `idle`

ing` | Waiting |
| `agent/error` within 4 s | `failed` | Failed |
| otherwise | `idle` | no bubble |

`Agent.status` itself is only `idle | running`; the waiting and failed rows come
from the two transi
ent Host events above.
## Architecture

The dsh Host writes `desktop/state.json`; `desktop/pet-window.pyw` polls it and
renders the desktop

window with tkinter + Pillow. The Host may start the pet,
but the pet process survives a Host restar

t. `desktop/setup-startup.ps1` can
also install a login shortcut that launches the pet independently

. `desktop/setup-startup.ps1` can
also install a login shortcut that launches the pet independently.

The process uses a per-monitor DPI-aware context so mixed-scale monitors keep
consistent sprite and

window coordinates. The pet seeds the user's AppData
settings from `desktop/default-settings.json`;

the right-click settings panel
writes to the per-user copy so plugin upgrades do not overwrite prefe

ht-click settings panel
writes to the per-user copy so plugin upgrades do not overwrite preferences.

The launcher prefers the newest packaged `desktop/dsh-pet-gujiguji-<version>.exe`,
so Windows users

do not need Python and upgrades can coexist with a currently
running pet. If no executable is availa

ble, Pillow and tkinter are required and
Python is resolved from `DSH_PET_PYTHON`, then `pyw.exe`, `

pythonw.exe`, `py.exe`,
and `python.exe` on `PATH`.
## Install

From the DSH plugin market, search for `dsh-pet-gujiguji` and install it, then
restart dsh. Or insta
ll the public npm package:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Python dependencies:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Windows is currently the only supported platform.
When upgrading from an earlier release, the pet au

tomatically migrates its
position and settings from `dsh-light-feather` or `dsh-mint-budgie`.
## Files

- `index.js` - Host state polling, persistence and desktop-process bridge
- `client.js` - compatibil

ity shim; intentionally registers no in-window pet
- `desktop/pet-window.pyw` - standalone desktop o

verlay
- `desktop/pet_physics.py` - dependency-free drag, throw, collision and landing physics
- `as

sets/spritesheet.png` - working/status sheet read by the desktop overlay
- `assets/poses/head-tilt_<
frame>.png` - aligned click gesture frames
## Disabling

Remove `dsh-pet-gujiguji` from `dsh.profile.bundles` in the active profile's
`package.json`, then re

h-pet-gujiguji` from `dsh.profile.bundles` in the active profile's
`package.json`, then restart dsh.
